title: Disk read errors during a low-memory search panic or read as no match
body:
In low-memory mode `SufrSearch` reads suffixes and text through `FileAccess` in `libsufr/src/file_access.rs`. `FileAccess::get` returns `Option<T>`:

```rust
let _ = self.file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(seek));
...
let bytes_read = self.file.read(&mut buffer).unwrap();
(bytes_read == mem::size_of::<T>()).then(|| ...)
```

`get` discards a seek error and panics on a read error. A short read returns `None`. `SufrSearch::get_suffix` and `get_text` pass that `None` up, and the binary search's `?` turns it into "no match". `SufrSearch::compare` calls `get_text_range(..).unwrap()`, which panics on any error from `FileAccess::get_range`.

A failing disk therefore surfaces as a panic in some paths and as a query with zero hits in others. In neither case does the caller get an `Err`. The function carries a comment saying the same: `TODO: Ignoring lots of Results to return Option`.

Found by reading the code. Not reproduced.
close_reason: Landed as 9049092 on refactor: FileAccess::get returns a Result and search returns Result<Hits>, so a failed read stops the command with the error instead of a panic or a silent no-match; extract and locate stop on a failed read of the suffixes too.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4be42394
notes.text:
At cff9fb6 `FileAccess` is in `io.rs`. `get` (`io.rs:127-143`) calls `read_exact_at(..).unwrap()` at :137, so a short read panics instead of reading as no match. `get` returns `None` only past the end. TODO at `io.rs:128`.

`compare` no longer unwraps `get_text_range`. `query_lcp` unwraps `text_slice` instead (`search.rs:277`, `search.rs:295`). `get_range` returns a `Result`. No disk error reaches the caller as `Err`.

notes.author: Jeb Rosen/f3787cc2
notes.text: Still present on dev at 657e16d: `FileAccess::get` in `libsufr/src/file_access.rs:66-81` returns `Option` and unwraps `read_exact_at`, and `sufr_search.rs:275` unwraps `get_text_range`. Fixing it on dev also needs the sufr-eae820 fix so the error reaches the caller.
